newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DSM sees higher H1 1997 profit.
newsitem.headline: DSM sees higher H1 1997 profit.

text.p: Dutch chemicals group DSM NV said on Tuesday that it expected a higher profit in the first half of 1997 than in the same period of 1996.
"There are no signs that the present favourable market conditions will change in a major way in the coming months," DSM said in a statement.
"Based on this, we expect the results for the first half of 1997 to be higher than those for the first half of 1996."
DSM said at the presentation of its 1996 results in February it expected first-half 1997 earnings to be comparable to those of the year-earlier period.
